<script>
(function(){
var ACT={
  surf:{badge:"🏄 SURF WEEK INCLUDES",items:["7 nights at Villa Sunset or Villa Zephyr (shared room, max 3 people)","Full board: fresh, homemade meals","12h of surf lessons, groups formed by level","Equipment included: boards adapted to your level and wetsuit","BBQ night and an evening out in town","Visit to a local argan cooperative of 100 women","Transfers to the spots and Essaouira airport, return"]},
  kite:{badge:"🪁 KITESURF WEEK INCLUDES",items:["7 nights at Villa Sunset or Villa Zephyr (shared room, max 3 people)","Full board: fresh, homemade meals","12h of kitesurf lessons, maximum 4 people per instructor, groups formed by level","Equipment included: helmet, wetsuit, harness, kites...","BBQ night and an evening out in town","Visit to a local argan cooperative of 100 women","Transfers to the spots and Essaouira airport, return"]}
};
var MONTHS={
  nov:{name:'Nov',dates:[{t:'7 → 14'},{t:'14 → 21'},{t:'21 → 28'},{t:'28 → Dec 5'}]},
  dec:{name:'Dec',dates:[{t:'5 → 12'},{t:'12 → 19'},{t:'19 → 26',off:1},{t:'26 → Jan 2',off:1}]},
  jan:{name:'Jan',dates:[{t:'2 → 9'},{t:'9 → 16'},{t:'16 → 23'},{t:'23 → 30'},{t:'30 → Feb 6'}]},
  feb:{name:'Feb',dates:[{t:'6 → 13'},{t:'13 → 20'},{t:'20 → 27'},{t:'27 → Mar 6'}]},
  mar:{name:'Mar',full:1,dates:[{t:'6 → 13'},{t:'13 → 20'},{t:'20 → 27'},{t:'27 → Apr 3'}]}
};
var PRICE={surf:550,kite:750};
var FULL={surf:790,kite:890};
var PROMO_END='2027-03-01';
function isFull(){
  if(s.date==='custom'){var f=g('bk-date-from').value;return !!f&&f>=PROMO_END;}
  return !!(s.month&&MONTHS[s.month]&&MONTHS[s.month].full);
}
function price(){return isFull()?FULL[s.act]:PRICE[s.act];}
var s={act:null,month:null,date:null,n:1};
function g(id){return document.getElementById(id)}
function warn(t){var u=g('bk-urgency');u.textContent=t;u.style.color='#c0392b';}
function clr(){g('bk-urgency').textContent='';}
function fmt(m,d){return MONTHS[m].name+' '+d.t;}
window.bkAct=function(a,btn){
  s.act=a;
  document.querySelectorAll('.bk-act').forEach(function(b){b.classList.remove('on')});
  btn.classList.add('on');clr();
  g('bk-act-badge').textContent=ACT[a].badge;
  g('bk-act-list').innerHTML=ACT[a].items.map(function(t){return '<li>'+t+'</li>'}).join('');
  upd();
};
window.bkMonth=function(m,btn){
  s.month=m;s.date=null;clr();
  document.querySelectorAll('#bk-months .bk-mbtn').forEach(function(b){b.classList.remove('on')});
  btn.classList.add('on');
  if(m==='custom'){
    s.date='custom';
    g('bk-dates-wrap').classList.remove('show');
    g('bk-custom-block').classList.add('show');
  }else{
    g('bk-custom-block').classList.remove('show');
    var box=g('bk-dates');box.innerHTML='';
    MONTHS[m].dates.forEach(function(d,i){
      var b=document.createElement('button');
      if(d.off){
        b.className='bk-date off';
        b.disabled=true;
        b.innerHTML=fmt(m,d)+'<small>Not available</small>';
      }else{
        b.className='bk-date';
        b.textContent=fmt(m,d);
        b.onclick=function(){
          s.date=m+i;
          box.querySelectorAll('.bk-date').forEach(function(x){x.classList.remove('on')});
          b.classList.add('on');clr();upd();
        };
      }
      box.appendChild(b);
    });
    g('bk-dates-wrap').classList.add('show');
  }
  upd();
};
window.bkUpd=function(){upd();};
window.bkCnt=function(d){s.n=Math.max(1,Math.min(13,s.n+d));g('bk-cnt').textContent=s.n;upd();};
function upd(){
  if(!s.act||!s.date){g('bk-price').classList.add('hidden');return;}
  var p=price();
  g('bk-price').classList.remove('hidden');
  g('bk-pamt').textContent='€'+(p*s.n).toLocaleString('en-GB');
  g('bk-psub').textContent='€'+p+' × '+s.n+(s.n>1?' people':' person')+(isFull()?' · regular rate':' · special rate (instead of €'+FULL[s.act]+')')+(s.n>=2?' · discount applied on confirmation':'');
}
function dlabel(){
  if(s.date==='custom')return 'From '+g('bk-date-from').value+' to '+g('bk-date-to').value;
  var m=s.month,i=parseInt(s.date.slice(3),10);
  return fmt(m,MONTHS[m].dates[i]);
}
window.bkNext=function(){
  if(!s.act){warn('⚠️ Please choose an activity');return;}
  if(!s.month){warn('⚠️ Please choose a month');return;}
  if(!s.date){warn('⚠️ Please choose your dates');return;}
  if(s.date==='custom'&&(!g('bk-date-from').value||!g('bk-date-to').value)){warn('⚠️ Please enter your dates');return;}
  var a=s.act==='surf'?'🏄 Surf':'🪁 Kitesurf';
  g('bk-sum').innerHTML='<strong>'+a+'</strong><br>'+dlabel()+' · '+s.n+(s.n>1?' people':' person')+' · €'+(price()*s.n).toLocaleString('en-GB');
  g('bk-s1').classList.remove('on');g('bk-s2').classList.add('on');
};
window.bkBack=function(){g('bk-s2').classList.remove('on');g('bk-s1').classList.add('on');};
window.bkSubmit=function(){
  var ok=true;
  ['bk-fn','bk-ln','bk-email'].forEach(function(id){var e=g(id);if(!e.value.trim()){e.classList.add('err');ok=false;}else{e.classList.remove('err');}});
  if(!ok)return;
  var btn=g('bk-btn2');btn.disabled=true;btn.textContent='Sending...';
  var a=s.act==='surf'?'Surf':'Kitesurf';
  var fd=new FormData();
  fd.append('access_key','REDACTED');
  fd.append('subject','🏄 Landing Booking · '+a+' · Mogasurf');
  fd.append('from_name','Mogasurf Website');
  fd.append('cc','info@mogasurf.com,redacted@example.com,redacted@example.com');
  fd.append('botcheck','');
  fd.append('Activity',a);
  fd.append('Stay dates',dlabel());
  fd.append('People',s.n);
  fd.append('Estimated total',(price()*s.n)+'€');
  fd.append('Rate',isFull()?'Normal rate':'Special rate (until end of Feb 2027)');
  fd.append('First name',g('bk-fn').value.trim());
  fd.append('Last name',g('bk-ln').value.trim());
  fd.append('Email',g('bk-email').value.trim());
  fd.append('Phone',g('bk-cc').value+' '+g('bk-phone').value.trim());
  if(g('bk-msg').value.trim())fd.append('Message',g('bk-msg').value.trim());
  fetch('https://api.web3forms.com/submit',{method:'POST',body:fd})
  .then(function(r){return r.json()})
  .then(function(d){
    if(d.success){
      g('bk-fields').style.display='none';g('bk-ok').classList.add('show');
      if(typeof fbq==='function')fbq('track','Lead');
      window.dataLayer=window.dataLayer||[];window.dataLayer.push({'event':'camp_booking_success'});
    }else{alert('Error. Please contact us on WhatsApp.');}
    btn.disabled=false;btn.textContent='Confirm my booking →';
  })
  .catch(function(){alert('Network error. WhatsApp: +212 618 910 431');btn.disabled=false;btn.textContent='Confirm my booking →';});
};
})();
</script>				</div>
